title: Integrate dev CI with Ruff, Black, tests, docs, and CodeQL

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Starting implementation: update CI for dev integration and PRs to include Ruff, Black check, tests/docs, and CodeQL analysis.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Implemented CI workflow updates: ci.yml now runs on main/dev push+PR and includes Black --check; added new codeql.yml workflow for Python on main/dev plus weekly schedule. Local run shows pre-existing Ruff and Black failures in repository code, so CI will surface those until codebase is brought into compliance.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Landed in commit f9159e1 and pushed to origin/feature/reinforcement-memory. CI now runs on dev/main pushes and PRs, adds Black check alongside Ruff, and includes a dedicated CodeQL workflow for Python security analysis.
